livecheck._comment: Only an explicit 404/410 removes a vehicle. Network errors keep it (fail-open) so an outage never empties the feed.

images._comment: MotorK burns the watermark in through a query string, on the AB feed only. Meta allows watermarked images, so we keep them there. Google explicitly disapproves images with a superimposed logo, so that feed requests the clean original.

meta._comment: Meta condition grade (EXCELLENT, GOOD, FAIR, POOR, OTHER). The field is optional and MotorK does not grade vehicles, so it is left empty rather than claiming a grade in the ad. Set it if you want one applied to every car.

google._comment: 'online' validates immediately. Switch to 'in_store' or 'both' once the store codes in stores.csv exist in the linked Google Business Profile.
